name: detect_anomalies_in_window
description: Automatically analyzes telemetry snapshots across a time window and identifies anomalies: (1) High-volume traffic floods (iperf / DoS surges in byte counters), (2) Rogue / unauthorized DROP flow rules blackholing hosts, and (3) Switch disconnections.

start_time.description: Beginning of the window (e.g. '03:00' or ISO timestamp '2026-10-07T03:00:00Z').

end_time.description: End of the window (defaults to start_time + 1 hour).

minutes_ago.description: Relative lookback in minutes from the present time (default: 30).
